titulo: Effect of Lutein, Zeaxanthin, and Meso-Zeaxanthin Supplementation on Macular Sensitivity in Patients With High Myopia

braco.texto: Participants received one oral softgel capsule daily with meals for six months. Each capsule contained 10 mg of lutein, 10 mg of meso-zeaxanthin, and 2 mg of zeaxanthin.

tituloPt: Efeito da suplementação de luteína, zeaxantina e meso-zeaxantina na sensibilidade macular em pacientes com alta miopia
